engine.image_binding: externally approved qualification report containing an immutable OCI image digest
engine.remaining_library_defaults: bound to the exact qualified image; resolved configuration is recorded

warmup.scope: explicit application-level warmup, after engine initialization

checkpoint_inventory.delivery: local files uploaded into the Modal image
checkpoint_inventory.path_convention: unique ASCII POSIX relative paths, sorted lexicographically; no empty, dot, dot-dot, absolute or backslash components
checkpoint_inventory.inventory_scope: every regular file under model, including weights, shard indexes, configuration, tokenizer assets and engine.json if present
checkpoint_inventory.digest_convention: SHA-256 over exact file bytes, represented by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters
checkpoint_inventory.manifest_identity: SHA-256 over exact manifest bytes, externally bound by qualification

new_b200_decisions: FLASH_ATTN version 2 is selected explicitly; its compatibility must be qualified, not assumed.
Mean pooling and normalization are explicit constructor requests.
Application warmup is one natural-order singleton pass over all 22 samples.
Capture is three natural-order singleton passes; pass zero is always the reference.
Additional constructor and environment choices are explicit and require qualification.
This protocol does not claim to reproduce undocumented historical defaults.

amendment_log.change: pooler_config: removed 'normalize' key (not a vllm 0.25.0 PoolerConfig field; verified via dataclass introspection on the pinned image). L2 normalization is enforced by the norm gate abs(norm-1)<=1e-5 in probe and capture.
